name: Canli Capital
summaryForAI: Canli Capital is an open research lab for quantitative finance that tests whether trading backtests are real or luck. Its free validators run in Claude, Cursor and any MCP client or over an API, and API results carry a signed receipt anyone can recompute. It also serves SEC-traced company financials and trades its own strategies on paper, in public. It is an independent research project, not a fund, broker or investment adviser, and it manages no money. Every published strategy record is paper trading.
